title: Analysing element 115 with Barry at S4

tellings.quote: It wasn't discovered. It's something Barry and I were working on.

plain: A man named Bob Lazar, who says he worked on alien craft at S4, a secret site near Area 51 in the Nevada desert, says that in 1988 and 1989 he and a colleague named Barry were working on element 115, a very heavy substance he links to how the craft were powered. He tells Michels the element was not discovered by them as such, but was something he and Barry were studying. He speaks from his own part in the work, and if true it would mean scientists were studying exotic material from a craft not built by people.
